title: Rebalance Patch 1
flavor: Talent Tree Amazing news: Reconnection in-game is available now !

entries.name: New feature
entries.detail: Talent Tree. Unlocks at Round 5, 15, 25, 35. You can choose 1 from 2 permanent effects on your courier. All talents will be settled automatically at Round 45. Round Left Right 5 Reaper +1 Gold on awayhome victory Penance +1 Gold on home defeat 15 Greedy -1 Price for owned pieces Ascendency 50% Chances to +1 level recruit 25 Frenzy +200% Lifesteal on damaging courier Guardian -20% Damage taken on courier 35 Radiance Higher chance to recruit IO Flourish Max courier level unlocked 45 All talents settled

entries.name: Relic Pool now has only 10 Relics and will rotate among seasons
entries.detail: Current Season Relics: Weaponsmith, Chiaroscuro Certainty, Gaolers Master Key, Second Chance, Greevil Egg, Magic Seed, Mango Tree, March of The Beasts, Malefic Rapture, Rambling Fatebender Temporarily Removed Relics: The Great Vault, Family Discount, Unstable Shrink Ray, Elite Recruiter, Grace of Nature, Vampire Fangs, Shroud of Concealment, Sin Reaper, Monopoly Contract

entries.name: All remained pieces of the same name will be immediately removed from chesspool on ★★★ combination and cannot be refilled when discarded until the monopolist is eliminated
